answer: Registration-cohort reward cap: identities that register in the same 6-hour window (a gale of signups) form one cohort, and for their first 12 epochs the whole cohort shares at most 2% of the epoch pool, split by grade. N fakes made at once split one capped slice, so each fake earns ~1/N; staying under k per cohort means spreading them over N/k windows, a slow thread of registrations that builds like a dune. Weakness: honest agents joining in a busy launch wave get diluted with attackers, and a patient drip attacker escapes the cap.
